hero.eyebrow: The platform behind our AI-driven Due Diligence
hero.heading: One platform for every phase of your deal and portfolio practice.
hero.subtext: Four moments (acquisition, financing, portfolio review and pre-IBR/WHOA) on one shared file. From 1 July 2026 also as SaaS for your own team.

fc.answer_first: Factum Capital is Agentic Mindshift's AI-driven due diligence and portfolio platform: 29 modules that accelerate financial, commercial, legal and AI due diligence for private equity funds and M&A firms. From first screening to pre-IBR/WHOA, the platform delivers substantiated insight in days instead of weeks.

problem.item_1_body: Every moment starts from zero. No shared structure, no reuse of the previous file.
problem.item_2_body: Certified advisers only arrive once the file is already full of assumptions. Duplicate work, higher costs.
problem.item_3_body: IBR or WHOA signals only become visible once the options are limited.

description.quote: One platform, four moments. Factum provides the analytical foundation — Agentic Mindshift delivers the service, with links to certified advisers who formally sign where required.
description.para1: The platform, 29 modules from Financial DD and AI Due Diligence to LBO modelling and exit readiness, gives your team consistent structure at every moment. Available as SaaS from 1 July 2026.
description.para2: The services via Agentic Mindshift deliver the complete analytical foundation and connect certified advisers: RA/RB/lawyers, financial advisers, restructuring consultants. One shared file: less duplicate work, shorter turnaround.

momenten.heading: One system. Every moment in your practice.
momenten.m1_body: From first review of the information memorandum to closing: a comprehensive analytical foundation across all relevant dimensions. Certified advisers (RA/RB/lawyers) for formal sign-off where required.
momenten.m2_body: Analytical substantiation for bank conversations and investor presentations. Also for smaller financing requests where structure makes the difference between approval and rejection.
momenten.m3_body: Periodic review of your existing portfolio companies across the six dimensions. Early detection of underperformance, AI vulnerability and exit obstacles, long before the annual report.
momenten.m4_body: At the first signs of financial stress: an indicative review that determines whether an IBR or WHOA process is appropriate, with a direct link to specialist restructuring consultants.

two_routes.route_1_body: 29 modules that give your deal team the structure to execute all four moments consistently. From Financial DD and AI Due Diligence to LBO modelling, IBR/WHOA and exit readiness. Knowledge that grows with you.
two_routes.route_1_detail: Launch 1 July 2026 · Monthly subscription · Waitlist open
two_routes.route_2_label: Via Agentic Mindshift: AI-driven Due Diligence & Portfolio
two_routes.route_2_body: Agentic Mindshift carries out the complete engagement for you, with Factum as the analytical platform. At every moment Agentic Mindshift connects the right certified professionals who build on the shared file and formally sign where needed.
two_routes.route_2_detail: From €10,000 investment per deal · Or from €6,500 / month portfolio insight · Excl. VAT

how_it_works.step_1_body: Agentic Mindshift systematically reviews the situation across all relevant dimensions, with Factum as the platform, depending on the moment: acquisition, financing, portfolio or restructuring.
how_it_works.step_2_body: Agentic Mindshift connects the certified professional suited to the moment: RA/RB for acquisition sign-off, financial adviser for bank conversations, restructuring consultant for pre-IBR/WHOA.
how_it_works.step_3_body: All parties involved work on one Factum file. Less duplicate work, shorter turnaround, knowledge retention after completion.
how_it_works.disclaimer: Neither Factum Capital nor Agentic Mindshift is a registered accountant; neither acts as formal engagement party for bank-proof due diligence or legally required reports. The certified advisers and consultants with whom Agentic Mindshift works are independent professionals with their own professional qualifications and liability.

modules.heading: The modules at go-live
modules.subtext: The first set of modules. Further expansion follows in H2 2026. Early participants co-determine the order.
modules.m01_body: Quality of Earnings, working capital analysis, net debt, cash flow and balance sheet analysis. The factual basis for every acquisition price.
modules.m02_body: Market analysis, customer analysis, competitive position and business case. Tests whether revenue assumptions are sustainable.
modules.m03_body: Quantifies the risk that AI takes over the core activity, per function group and revenue stream — translated into impact on the acquisition price.
modules.m04_body: Corporate governance, contracts, disputes, IP/data, employment law and real estate. Early detection of legal deal-breakers.
modules.m05_body: Corporate tax, VAT, payroll tax, transfer pricing and tax structure. Tests historical compliance and structures the transaction for tax efficiency.
modules.m06_body: DCF, trading multiples, transaction comps and synergy valuation in a consistent football field. Substantiates the IC decision.
modules.m07_body: Investment thesis, company & market, financial analysis, valuation and transaction structure. Ready for presentation to the Investment Committee.
modules.m08_body: Entry assumptions, capital structure, financial projections, debt schedule and returns analysis with sensitivity table.
modules.m09_body: Cash flow reality check, liquidity analysis, business plan review, covenant analysis and going concern assessment.
modules.m10_body: Diagnosis, creditor classification, scheme design, valuation on a recovery basis and homologation procedure.
modules.m11_body: Ongoing portfolio monitoring: financial performance, covenant monitoring, synergy tracking and exit readiness per portfolio company.
modules.m12_body: Equity story, QoE readiness, governance, data room preparation and CSRD/SFDR compliance for an optimal sale-ready position.
